text:
Noah: Quick check-in  do we prefer proto-first gRPC internally with an edge JSON facade, or keep JSON everywhere? Thinking about quotas, canonical route labels, and console UX for rollouts.

Priya: Proto-first for perf. Metadata fields in gRPC make variant/quota tagging cheap.

Carlos: Agreed. But we need a single canonical label for telemetry. Suggest gateway writes X-Canonical-Route like inference.chat.completions.v1.

Marta (PM): Console needs stable human labels and a canary compare view. Canonical header + variant tags should cover it.

Noah: Importantgateway must overwrite any incoming header and record original path in logs for debugging.

Priya: Envoy transform can do that. We'll also copy canonical into trace tags.

Carlos: Quota format proposal: tenant|canonical_route. We'll hash for storage but keep readable labels in UI.

Marta (PM): During migration show legacy route alongside canonical in charts. Teams need reconciliation.

Noah: Action items: Priya prototype envoy header transform + header->grpc metadata bridge. Carlos draft quota key docs. Marta mock dashboard migration view.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy: transport-facade-spike v0.1 -> canary group (4/4) :white_check_mark:

Priya: I'll land a tiny Lua filter today and post snippet.

Carlos: Will add quota mapping doc to the spike ticket.

Marta (PM): Timeline: 3-day spike, demo Friday.

Noah: Cool, thanks all.
